# Parth Khansali

> Computer science student and software developer based in Dehradun, India. Developer of GEHU Connect, a campus networking app actively used by roughly a thousand students, and Netwich, a native macOS multi-interface network bonding utility.

## Identity
- Name: Parth Khansali
- Given Name: Parth
- Surname: Khansali
- Handle: @ParthKhansali
- Location: Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India
- Education: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering at Graphic Era Hill University (2024 to 2028)
- Role: Director General, Graphic Era Model United Nations Club (2024 to present)

## Main Projects
- [GEHU Connect](https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/gehu-connect): Campus community mobile app (React Native, Expo, Java Spring Boot, Cloudflare R2) used by roughly 1,000 students at GEHU.
- [Netwich](https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/netwich): Native macOS 14+ link bonding app in Swift 6 and SwiftUI using a local SOCKS5 proxy and `IP_BOUND_IF` ([GitHub](https://github.com/ParthKhansali/Netwich)).
- [ARANYA](https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/aranya): Geospatial wildlife conflict intelligence platform piloted along the Rajaji-Corbett corridor in Uttarakhand ([GitHub](https://github.com/ParthKhansali/Project-Aranya)).
- [ORVESS-PAT](https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/orvess-pat): Optical tracking and free-space optical communication simulation suite in Python with sub-pixel centroiding and Monte Carlo sweeps.
- [Meghavyuha](https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/meghavyuha): TypeScript meteorological forecast workspace deployed at [meghavyuha.vercel.app](https://meghavyuha.vercel.app).
